description: Control the Gopeed download manager from your AI agent — create/pause/resume/delete download tasks, list tasks, and read or update Gopeed config via natural language.

GOPEED_API_URL.description: Gopeed REST API base URL. Leave the port empty so the server auto-discovers the random Gopeed port.

GOPEED_API_TOKEN.description: Optional Gopeed API token, only needed if Gopeed enforces token auth.
